Redash <=10.0.0 default REDASH_COOKIE_SECRET / SECRET_KEY (CVE-2021-41192) = forgeable session cookie = auth bypass on the login-walled tier.
Post-auth data-source / query-runner SSRF reachable to cloud IMDS; chains off a setup-wizard admin claim.
